angles.angle: Adaptability and digital literacy are likely to outweigh specific technical skills in the future job market
angles.example: workers who can quickly learn new software tend to outlast those with narrow, outdated expertise

angles.angle: Self-study suits motivated learners but lacks the structure and feedback of formal education
angles.example: online courses let you learn at your own pace, but without a mentor, gaps in understanding can go uncorrected

angles.angle: An overemphasis on academic subjects can leave graduates underprepared for practical workplace demands
angles.example: a graduate with strong theoretical knowledge may still struggle with basic workplace communication

angles.angle: Online learning has democratised access to skills but raised concerns about quality and credential value
angles.example: anyone with internet access can now learn coding, though employers still question how rigorous some courses are

angles.angle: Soft skills like communication and teamwork are increasingly valued alongside technical ability
angles.example: many employers now rank collaboration skills as highly as coding ability in tech hiring
